BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives MacEwen, Stanford, Muri, Young, Kilduff, and Shea
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning military student participation in varsity extracurricular activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to military student participation in varsity extracurricular activities; and amending RCW 28A.225.280.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28A.225.280 and 2006 c 263 s 903 are each amended to read as follows:Transfer students' eligibility for extracurricular activities.
BillSection.P: Eligibility of transfer students under RCW 28A.225.220 and 28A.225.225 for participation in extracurricular activities shall be subject to rules adopted by the Washington interscholastic activities association. The Washington interscholastic activities association may not require a transfer student who is a child of an active duty military family to meet continuous enrollment prerequisites before becoming eligible for varsity-level extracurricular activities.
